entries.summaryZh: 公元351年9月28日，东部皇帝君士坦提乌斯二世与西部篡位者马格嫩提乌斯在潘诺尼亚的穆尔萨（今克罗地亚奥西耶克）附近决战。双方投入大量蛮族部队，战斗极其惨烈，马格嫩提乌斯战败退往意大利。此役虽保住君士坦提乌斯的皇位，却严重消耗了帝国的兵力。
entries.summaryEn: On 28 September 351 the eastern emperor Constantius II and the western usurper Magnentius fought at Mursa in Pannonia, modern Osijek in Croatia. Both sides fielded large barbarian contingents in one of the bloodiest battles of Roman history, and Magnentius withdrew towards Italy. Constantius kept the throne but the empire's manpower was badly drained.
entries.significanceZh: 穆尔萨是罗马内战中最血腥的战役之一，其消耗加速了高卢与巴尔干防线的空虚。
entries.significanceEn: Mursa was among the bloodiest of Roman civil-war battles and its cost accelerated the weakening of the Rhine and Balkan frontiers.
entries.notesZh: 伤亡数字（常引五万余人）出自后世作家且被普遍认为夸大；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The casualty figure often given, above 50,000, comes from later writers and is widely thought inflated; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1914年10月28日，德国东亚舰队的埃姆登号轻巡洋舰突袭槟威海峡，击沉俄国防护巡洋舰珍珠号与法国驱逐舰火枪号，造成一百三十余名法俄水兵丧生，随后安全撤离。埃姆登号此前的印度洋破交作战已牵制大量协约国军舰，此次袭击进一步打击了协约国航运信心。
entries.summaryEn: On 28 October 1914 the German light cruiser SMS Emden raided Penang harbour in the Straits of Malacca, sinking the Russian protected cruiser Zhemchug and the French destroyer Mousquet and killing more than 130 Allied sailors before escaping. The attack followed months of commerce raiding in the Indian Ocean that had tied down many Allied warships.
entries.significanceZh: 槟城海战是第一次世界大战远东战区最著名的海战之一，暴露了协约国港口防御的疏漏。
entries.significanceEn: Penang was one of the best-known naval actions in the Far East during the First World War and exposed gaps in Allied port defence.
entries.notesZh: 死亡人数各来源为一百三十至一百四十余人，珍珠号弹药库爆炸的原因亦无定论；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Death tolls range from about 130 to the mid-140s and the cause of the Zhemchug's magazine explosion is disputed; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元268年末或269年初，阿勒曼尼人与朱通吉人越过阿尔卑斯山进入意大利北部，罗马皇帝克劳狄二世率军在加尔达湖（古称贝纳库斯湖）沿岸将其击败。此役与纳伊苏斯之战同年，共同构成克劳狄二世阻击蛮族入侵的军事成果，意大利本土得以保全。
entries.summaryEn: In late 268 or early 269 the Alamanni and Juthungi crossed the Alps into northern Italy and were defeated by the army of the emperor Claudius II along Lake Garda, known to the Romans as Benacus. Together with Naissus in the same period, the victory checked the invasions and kept Italy proper intact.
entries.significanceZh: 贝纳库斯湖战役阻止了蛮族深入意大利本土，是三世纪危机中罗马少数本土防御成功的战例。
entries.significanceEn: Lake Benacus stopped the invaders from penetrating Italy and was one of the few successful homeland defences of the third-century crisis.
entries.notesZh: 年份在268年末与269年初之间两说，阿勒曼尼人兵力亦无可靠数字；本条采用268年并只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The date is given as late 268 or early 269 and Alamannic numbers are unknown; this entry uses 268 with year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1260年12月10日，伊儿汗国将领拜答儿率军进攻叙利亚，与霍姆斯与哈马的阿尤布王室军队及马木留克援军在霍姆斯附近会战。蒙古军被击败并被迫撤退，阿勒颇等地随后被马木留克方面收回。这是阿音札鲁特之后蒙古军在叙利亚的又一次失败。
entries.summaryEn: On 10 December 1260 an Ilkhanate force under Baidar advanced into Syria and was defeated near Homs by the Ayyubid princes of Homs and Hama with Mamluk reinforcements. The Mongols withdrew and Aleppo and other towns returned to Mamluk control. It was a second Mongol failure in Syria after Ain Jalut.
entries.significanceZh: 第一次霍姆斯之战证明阿音札鲁特并非偶然，伊儿汗国短期内难以在叙利亚立足。
entries.significanceEn: First Homs showed that Ain Jalut was no accident and that the Ilkhanate could not hold Syria at that point.
entries.notesZh: 蒙古军兵力（数千至万余）与叙方联军规模在不同史料中差异较大；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Mongol strength, given as a few thousand to over ten thousand, and the size of the Syrian coalition differ between sources; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1281年夏，元朝与高丽再度出兵征日，东路军与江南军分两路进攻九州，在博多湾一带与日军激战。日军依托石垒抵御，元军未能取得登陆突破，两路舰队会合后遭台风重创，残部撤回。日本称这次台风为神风，第二次元日战争以失败告终，元朝此后未再组织跨海征日。
entries.summaryEn: In the summer of 1281 Yuan China and Goryeo again invaded Japan with two fleets that attacked Kyushu and fought the Japanese around Hakata Bay. The defenders held behind stone walls and the invaders failed to break through; after the fleets joined, a typhoon destroyed much of them and the survivors withdrew. Japan called the storm kamikaze.
entries.significanceZh: 弘安之役的失败使元朝放弃征服日本，也强化了日本镰仓幕府的防御体制与神国观念。
entries.significanceEn: The failure of the second invasion ended Yuan attempts to conquer Japan and strengthened the Kamakura shogunate's defensive system.
entries.notesZh: 元军规模与船只数量在后世记载中从数千艘到十万余艘不等，普遍认为夸大；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Later accounts give Yuan fleets of anything from several thousand to over 100,000 ships and are widely considered inflated; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1755年6月3日至16日，蒙克顿中校率英军从劳伦斯堡出发围攻希格内克托地峡的博塞茹尔堡，法军小规模驻军在炮击后投降。英军由此控制地峡，切断魁北克与路易斯堡之间的联系，并随即开始驱逐阿卡迪亚居民，阿卡迪亚人被大批迁往英属北美各地。
entries.summaryEn: From 3 to 16 June 1755 a British force under Lieutenant-Colonel Robert Monckton besieged Fort Beausejour on the Isthmus of Chignecto and its small French garrison surrendered after bombardment. Britain thereby controlled the isthmus, cut the link between Quebec and Louisbourg and began the deportation of the Acadians.
entries.significanceZh: 博塞茹尔堡之战结束了勒卢特尔神父之战，并直接引出对阿卡迪亚人的大规模驱逐。
entries.significanceEn: Fort Beausejour ended Father Le Loutre's War and led directly to the mass deportation of the Acadians.
entries.notesZh: 围攻起止日期与法军投降时间各来源略有差异，守军人数约一百五十至二百人；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Sources differ slightly on the siege dates and the surrender, and the garrison numbered about 150 to 200; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前202年，刘邦与韩信等诸侯联军在垓下（今安徽境内）包围项羽的楚军。汉军夜唱楚歌动摇楚军士气，项羽率八百骑突围南走，最终在乌江边自刎。此战是中国古代著名的围歼战例，汉军以绝对优势完成合围。楚汉战争至此结束，刘邦称帝建立汉朝。
entries.summaryEn: In 202 BC the allied forces of Liu Bang and Han Xin surrounded Xiang Yu's Chu army at Gaixia in Anhui. Songs from Chu sung at night broke the besieged army's morale; Xiang Yu escaped south with 800 riders and finally took his own life by the Wu River. The Chu-Han contention ended and Liu Bang founded the Han dynasty.
entries.significanceZh: 垓下之战终结了楚汉相争，直接决定了汉朝四百年统治的开端。
entries.significanceEn: Gaixia ended the Chu-Han war and opened four centuries of Han rule.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基记为公元前202年，英文维基记为公元前203年12月，两说并存；本条采用中文维基的公元前202年并只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia dates the battle to 202 BC while English Wikipedia gives December 203 BC; this entry follows 202 BC and keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元69年四帝之年，贝德里亚库姆（今意大利卡尔瓦托内附近）先后发生两场会战。4月，维提里乌斯的莱茵军团击败皇帝奥托的军队，奥托自杀；10月，拥护维斯帕先的东方军团在同一地区击败维提里乌斯派，维提里乌斯被杀，弗拉维王朝由此建立。
entries.summaryEn: In AD 69, the Year of the Four Emperors, two battles were fought near Bedriacum in northern Italy. In April Vitellius's Rhine legions defeated the army of the emperor Otho, who killed himself; in October the eastern legions supporting Vespasian beat the Vitellian forces and Vitellius was killed, beginning the Flavian dynasty.
entries.significanceZh: 贝德里亚库姆的两场会战决定了四帝之年的结局，也确立了军团推举皇帝的权力格局。
entries.significanceEn: The two battles at Bedriacum decided the Year of the Four Emperors and confirmed the legions' power to make emperors.
entries.notesZh: 两场会战实际发生在贝德里亚库姆与克雷莫纳之间，故又称第一次与第二次克雷莫纳之战，年份同为69年；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Both battles were fought between Bedriacum and Cremona and are also called the first and second battles of Cremona, both in AD 69; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元788年9月，阿拔斯王朝军队入侵拜占庭小亚细亚，在科皮德纳顿与拜占庭军队交战并将其击败。拜占庭方面损失了一名名为第欧根尼的官员，一些学者认为他就是史诗英雄狄吉尼斯·阿克里特的原型。此役后阿拉伯方面继续对安纳托利亚发动袭扰。
entries.summaryEn: In September 788 an Abbasid army invaded Byzantine Asia Minor and defeated a Byzantine force at Kopidnadon. Among the Byzantine dead was an officer named Diogenes, whom some scholars identify as the probable origin of the epic hero Digenes Akritas. Arab raids into Anatolia continued afterwards.
entries.significanceZh: 科皮德纳顿之战是八世纪末阿拔斯袭扰战的典型一役，也为拜占庭史诗传统留下了可能的史源。
entries.significanceEn: Kopidnadon typifies the late eighth-century Abbasid raids and may preserve the historical seed of a Byzantine epic hero.
entries.notesZh: 战役具体日期（9月）与双方兵力在古代史料中记载简略，战场位置今地不明；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Ancient sources give only September for the date and little on numbers, and the site is unidentified; this entry keeps year precision.
